chapter: Kline 1980: early years and founding of the Goldkette orchestra
title: Howard Lanin and Ted Weems bands
summary: He says Lanin and Weems both led jazz bands, Lanin more jazz than his brother Lester's sweet style, but recalls little else.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: And then you went to Howard Lanin.
Right. Do you remember anything about their bands?
Tell me about their bands. What kind of bands did they have?
Both Howard Lanin and Ted Weems?
Is Howard Lanin the brother of Lester Lanin? Is that the same family?
Because Lester Lanin plays sweet, more like Guy Lombardo. Was Howard Lanin more jazz than that?
It was. Do you remember anything else about their bands, about the time you had with them?
